name: customer-balances-by-conversion-batch
evidence: reports.py BALANCES_SQL (services/legacy-billing/app/reports.py:83-89, ap-c9b3d38c2c): customer count, current balance and past-due totals per conversion_batch_no (the :batch_no bind replaced by GROUP BY)
source_sql: SELECT conversion_batch_no AS "batchNo", COUNT(*) AS "customerCount", NVL(SUM(cur_bal_amt), 0) AS "currentBalanceTotal", NVL(SUM(past_due_amt), 0) AS "pastDueTotal" FROM customer_master GROUP BY conversion_batch_no

name: customer-first-by-tenant
evidence: facade.py GET /customer (services/legacy-billing/app/facade.py:287, ap-e45fe9768e; :121-126, ap-bd510b9356): first customer of a tenant by cust_seq_no; folded to one row per TENANT_ID pointer (200 of 201 pointers are orphans by design, d-orphan-cm-tenant)
source_sql: SELECT tenant_id AS "tenantId", COUNT(*) AS "customers", MIN(cust_seq_no) AS "firstCustSeqNo", MAX(cust_seq_no) AS "lastCustSeqNo" FROM customer_master GROUP BY tenant_id

name: customer-eav-attributes
evidence: facade.py GET /customer attributes read (services/legacy-billing/app/facade.py:294-296, ap-6c1786cb2d): entity_attr_value rows of a customer (entity_type = 'CUSTOMER'), read from the attributes embed; one row per customer that has attributes
source_sql: SELECT entity_id AS "custId", COUNT(*) AS "attributes", MIN(attr_name) AS "firstAttrName", MAX(eav_id) AS "lastEavId" FROM entity_attr_value WHERE entity_type = 'CUSTOMER' GROUP BY entity_id
